notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); Taxes split by the fund schedules (pp14, 16) and tied to the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2); Intergovernmental split by the fund schedules' rows (pp14, 16); Other split into NPPD lease and Franchise fees (p2) and the remaining fund 'Other' lines. Governmental roll-forward on fund balance: 4,104,823 + 1,439,183 - 1,678,584 + 26,150 - 218,358 = 3,673,214. Cash fields: governmental funds cash and cash equivalents + cash at county treasurer (2022 comparative column for beginning); CDs and investments in the investment fields; cash alone does not roll forward because CDs moved and the CCC Inn fund has a 64,082 liability (p3). Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statements (pp9-10): 1,339,916 + 769,027 - 777,681 + 192,208 = 1,523,470; Miscellaneous operating revenue is in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities, so charges for services. proprietary from the modified cash Statement of Cash Flows (pp11-12); investing activities blank. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position (p1), used because the governmental funds statement excludes capital assets. Detail: General Fund by department (pp14-15), Special Revenue combining (pp16-17, all 8 funds), utility funds from the supplementary accrual-basis proprietary statement (pp20-21, per FY2024 practice). Not recorded to avoid double counting: all-funds budget schedule (p13, combined), nonmajor combining (pp18-19, duplicates Recycling, Community Development, ARPA, TIF, Ambulance; Hoferer Trust has no activity), accrual cash flows (pp22-23).
